Official Statement of the Kingdom of Ekpatanus  
Date: 17 September 2026  
Government Spokesperson: Jürgen Andropoulos

The Kingdom of Ekpatanus reminds all parties that the recent military and economic tensions could easily escalate into an irreversible war  a war in which the only true losers would be the defenseless people of Tallisland. Rather than turning Tallisland into scorched earth, we propose a temporary ceasefire and the immediate opening of negotiations on the future of Tallisland between the members of the EDU and FNTO, the Anti-Principalist government of Tallisland, and its allies, to be hosted in a neutral country.

Should this proposal be ignored, the Kingdom of Ekpatanus will, after 72 hours, be obliged to initiate economic and political sanctions against the Second Flouesch Republic and Thýven.

[Spoiler=Sunvilllage Reports] [i][u][b]===EAS The Enclave National Emergency===[/b][/u]

Issued By: The Federal Enclave Bureau of Investigation (F.E.B.I.)
Affected Area: Oakis National Park and surrounding residential zones

The F.E.B.I. has received multiple reports of missing civilians within the boundaries of Oakis National Park. Local residents contacted authorities after seven children reportedly vanished while exploring the wooded area earlier today.

The Oceanic Government has dispatched Private Federal Enclave Bureau of Investigation Agents to conduct a full scale search and recovery operation.
At this time, no further details have been released. Residents near Oakis National Park are urged to remain alert, avoid entering the forest, and report any suspicious activity or unusual sounds to the nearest Enclave Field Command Post.

This is an active investigation. Stand by for additional information.
Cuts Video*

This is the Broadcast Radio from EBC News. Today, there will be heavy rainfall at 5:31 PM across Sunvillage County. In international news, a once cold war between the United Lavian Republic and the United States of Oceanic has now been officially placed in the past. Both governments have signed the Agros Friendship Accord Agreement, marking a new era for Agros Peace.
But trouble brews elsewhere, a violent demonstrations continue in Tallisland, where USO peacekeeping forces have been deployed to assist local law enforcement. Rising tensions and growing threats from the Second Flousech Republic and Thýven are now pushing  USO and EDU allies to the brink of political conflict in Tallsialdn conflict. Now back to

The transmission cuts to silence. Static lingers. As a faint tone hums. John Walker adjusts the radio dial, tapping the receiver as he tries to regain the lost signal. Only the faint murmur of static responds. He exhales, his eyes narrowing toward the foggy treeline of Oakis National Park, barely visible through heavy rain.

John Walker, a Federal Enclave Bureau of Investigation, has been assigned to lead the search for seven missing children who vanished without a trace two nights ago. At first, the call came from a single household in Sunvillage County. A mother returning home from a late shift at 10:30 PM, expecting to find her son and his three friends asleep. Instead, she found their bikes left outside, the door unlocked, and silence filling of the house. She dialed each of their phones, but no replies came.

Within hours, two more families reported their own children missing, and three more names were added to the growing list. All lived near the southern area of Oakis National Park. Locals recall seeing flashlights flicker among the trees around 9:03 PM, though no one could say for sure if they were the children.

Now, with seven total children missing, the community is left in shock by the whole nation of  USO. Parents keep their doors locked, schools have suspended evening activities, and the spread of strange sounds coming from the forest in Oakis National Park.

Walker checks his field tablet, where the F.E.B.I. search map flickers. Red markers highlight the missing childrens last known locations, all within a few kilometers of one another. The coordinates form a crude line leading deep into the woods, ending near an unmarked sector of the park simply labeled Zone 7A  Restricted.

John Walker 
Zone 7A why there?

The rain intensifies against the roof of his car. The forest seems alive, moving with shapes that vanish when stared at too long a distance. He switches off the radio. It doesnt matter anymore, the signals gone. He opens the door, flashlight in hand, and steps into the mist.

John Walker 
F*ck, I forgot my keys. God dam it, lock my keys in my car. Crap!
Snap*

John Walker 
Whose their?!

He looks out to the woods as rain heavily pours down the road. John Walker Nothing, just mist and rain. Could be just some animalsanyways

Unknow
Hello, sir.do you know where I am?

John Walker freezes. His breath catches. Slowly, he turns.
A non-human child wearing a coat, looks terrible.
 
John Walker
Hey hey, its alright. You dont have to worry,  Im with the F.E.B.I. Can you tell me your name? Or which species are you from? 

Unknow
I dont remember.

John Walker
That's fine, I would take you to the deputy's office, but first I need to check the signal. He checks his phone, and the signal seems to come back

John Walker
Well, guess my signal has finally come back. I will call my guys to pick us up.

Unknow
Whats a signal? And why do you have a small metal table on your hand?

John Walker
Sorry?
(quietly, to himself)
Oakis cases just got a hell of a lot stranger.

Unknow
So this is what surface dwellers live like nowadays?

John Walker
 Surface dwellers? What do you mean by that?

The child doesnt answer. They turn slightly toward the tree line, eyes fixed on something deeper in the forest, something unseen.
Walker tightens his grip on the flashlight.

John Walker
 MmmmWhat the hell are you?

The child slowly turns back to him, rain streaming down their face.

Unknown
 I am from underground, Misterjust like them.

John Walker
 Kid, what are you saying?! Whos them?!

Unknown
 Wait so you humans havent known? The war  between man and beast?

Silence*

Walker stares in open confusion. His flashlight trembles in his hand.

John Walker
Man and beast?

Unknown
 They went below when the surface burned. Our kind stayed. We were forgotten. The woods became our shelter from the war. You humans built over this land.
Walker steps back and, confused rises. 

John Walker
 Listen whatever you mean, well talk about it back to town, alright? Somewhere safe.
 (he forces a calm smile)
 You must be freezing. Lets get out of this rain.

The child looks up, blinking through the rain.

 Safe? You call this safe?

Walkers phone buzzes suddenly, making him flinch. The screen lights up  through the rain 

He answers quickly, voice shaky.

John Walker
 Walker here. Yeah, Ive found something. A kid. Not sure what

Dispatcher 
 Copy that. Were tracking your signal. The storms cleared just enough, but the transport units are coming to pick you up. ETA fifteen minutes. Well take you both back to Sunvillage Urban District.
Walker exhales hard.

John Walker
 Alright. Copy. Well be waiting on the road.

He pockets the phone and looks back at the child.
He hasnt moved only watching me, his expression unreadable.

John Walker
 (quietly, to himself)
 F.E.B.I. transports on the way. Well get you somewhere dry, kid.

The child gives a small nod.

Unknown
 They wont like that I spoke to you

Walker
 Who wont

But before he can finish, the child looks away, silent again. 15 minutes past, and the storm rolls overhead. Headlights faintly in the distance as the transport team approaches.
Walker sighs and looks up at the night sky. Rain still falls, but the feeling feels heavier now slower, deliberate. He glances one last time at the woods. The trees seem to shift in the dark, almost as if something unseen is watching them back.
[/i][/Spoiler]

[Spoiler=[b][strike]Don't[/strike] Fear the Reaper[/b]]

The ultimatum expired. Nobody believed that threatening violence would make the coalition back down, for they'd already been tear-gassed and sometimes shot at. As a result, High War-Priest Wojciech Saebaldr granted permission for the Tallislandic military to respond in force to restore order in all cities nationwide. 

The immediate concern was to relieve pressure off of Hoscbus and Jaerlic, two crucial cities that were surrounded by coalition-held lands. 20 IC-7 APCs were dispatched alongside 13 Śu-72 attack helicopters, and 12,000 soldiers. Their goals were to regain control of the Ofenhind peninsula, starting with Lukylod and working their way south to Ironlorkston. 

An equally sized force would be sent to Górzynka, to retake the Eyjafjollum region from the Young Tallialandics part of the coalition, although this group included 12 T-11 attack jets part of the "Sfinks" squadron, and 2 C-2 Eagle aircraft under the names AWACS Chefrena and AWACS Cheeseburger. 

On September 9th, only a day before the ultimatum was set to expire, Kjersti Stennes from a temporary hideout in Miswig, gave orders to attack the Office of the Navy in Karwbridc, and to seize all equipment from Karwbridc Harbor. The Office was not a single building but rather several across the naval installation at Karwbridc, and included a barracks building, an academy building, an administrative building, armory, and the ports themselves. 

Each building had been fortified in anticipation of an assault, with local police forces from the city and surrounding regions rallying here at the Office to fight alongside better trained soldiers. Machine Gun positions, sandbag walls, abandoned police cars, jersey barriers, anything the Office could get it's hands on they used to turn itself into a fortress. And that's not even mentioning the ships docked within the ports.

The main ship docked was the flagship BMW Baptism of Morawik aircraft carrier, containing 16 R-15 Orzeł STOL fighters. Additionally, 8 patrol boats, 2 corvettes, 3 cruisers, a destroyer, and a frigate had arrived to defend the base. Not including the crew of the ships, around 6,000 were ready to defend the Office, of which roughly a sixth were local law enforcement officers.

The attacking Anti-Principalists had managed to convince 40,000 to march on the Office, equipping toughly half of those 40k with weapons dropped through shipments from United Hydronia. With little to no ammunition however, most would be forced to use a single magazine before tossing the weapon or picking up something the Tallislandics had dropped. 

Michał Grabarczyk, a Karwbridc local was assigned with leading the charge into the Office, and spoke outside of the gates to the makeshift fortress for several hours giving words of encouragement to the protestors and rioters that had gathered. 

By five P.M the automatic daylight-sensor lights of the Office kicked on, which signaled that the attack was to begin. "The Cudzothko never cared for democracy, it was only ever justification for their oppression of true Tallialandics. This faux democracy and their oppression ends today!"

 Those were the final words spoken by Grabarczyk before the gates to the Office were breached by rioters, to which Tallislandic soldiers reluctantly opened fire upon. Atleast thirty were cut down in the first charge, hit by standard 556 infantry rounds and even the 12.7mm armor piercing rounds. It was a gory affair, rioters charging past the corpses toward the soldiers and officers like zombies, some being beaten to death and others being chained up. The Young Tallislandics in the crowd returned fire to rooftop snipers, detaching KMDK machine guns to pelt snipers with armor piercing rounds. 

The single Mikavonov frigate stationed at the Office loaded it's cannon to fire gas shells at the rioters hoping to drive them back, only for them to begin donning homemade masks made from bandanas and other clothes. Subsequently, panicked, the lead officer granted permission to load cluster munitions, which were fired without gaining permission from the rest of the stationed fleet.

Dozens killed instantly, dozens more injured or filled with shrapnel. Even several Tallislandic soldiers were killed by the cluster munitions. The advance of the rebels was indeed halted, if only for a couple seconds. Enraged at the countless deaths of their comrades, the rebels charged for the armory, intending to take the rocket launchers there to destroy the ships docked at the port. 

The rebels grinded through the lobby of the armory, fighting intense room-to-room combat against the soldiers. Naturally the soldiers had an advantage in training, but there was simply too many for them to deal with. All of the soldiers in the armory were rounded up, and tortured into teaching the rebels there how to operate the weaponry. 

To limit what could be taken, the Tallislandic navy again took the insane decision to fire an anti-ship missile at the building to prevent the rebels from seizing the armament in the building, killing around 3,000 individuals including their own allies. 

This was enough to warrant both the surrender of soldiers in the barracks and the academy building due to grief, and the orders from Kjersti Stennes to [i]send in the reinforcements.[/i]

Gründer Industries had been a close ally to Stennes and her Young Tallisland, and had given some of it's newest equipment to the AWN to test out in Nevonia and in Flousech, including the X-00 5th generation stealth fighter and XB-00 stealth bomber variant. Eight XB-00s took off from Brëckaloo, accompanied by twelve X-00s from Aardbuer in the Azraël squadron.

These aircraft bore the symbols of the Free Tallisland movement: a triangle with seven stars in it, and some Gründer iconography. By morning of September 10, the Azraël squadron arrived in style. Anti-ship missiles were launched from 4 of the XB-00s, disabling both cruisers, and two corvettes. An additional two XB-00s dropped fuel-air-explosive-bombs on the deck of the Baptism of Morawik, preventing hostile aircraft from taking off to put up a resistance.

Emboldened by the friendly air-power, some of the soldiers that had switched sides joined the rebellion in making the final charge into the administrative building of the office. Again, their training was dwarfed by that of their enemy, especially now that they were fighting the special forces contingent assigned to the protection of the High Naval-priest.

What advantage they did hold was quickly replaced by increasingly better armed rebels and even some deserters, who swept through every floor of the building before finally taking the High Naval-priest into custody. The rebellion stormed the docked ships after, forcing them all to surrender or be shot.

Michał Grabarczyk, assigned to administer the office now by the Coalition, did his best to prevent war crimes being committed against the prisoners, to around 50% effectiveness. Two firing squad executions were arranged without his permission, to which the perpetrators were quickly chained alongside those they had just attempted to kill. The decision was made by Grabarczyk to move all soldiers in his custody to the barracks and lock it off, patrolling the building routinely and making something of a temporary prison.

The following day, September 11th 2026, Holy President Clifford Prisk made a national statement regarding the seizure of the Naval Command Office. "Tallislandic heroes defeated the pagans, dethroned the monarchists, toppled the Islamists, saved Christian values, upheld Lusandric principles and chased down the terrorists to the very ends of Erene. We are now in the process of defeating the radicals the communists, the anarchists, the ethno-nationalists, the looters and people who in many instances have absolutely no clue what they are doing. Those that carried out unholy and gruesome attacks against our faithful troops in Karwbridc will face the full wrath of God, I can assure all Tallislandics and even those abroad, who would see myself and my people as weak. But know this, Erene. Tallisland will remain as the longest lasting democracy in this planet so long as I live, and I shan't allow these leftist-paganistic-eco-terrorists to subvert the greatest Christian state in the history of Erene." 

By now, a civil war was truly underway. Smaller troop movements would be made around Górzynka by the government to encircle rebel movements, and the AWN would properly enter the war by seizing the Szbulban islands of Szczepanik, Drzewiecki, Czochralski, Kotschy, and Pasha. Their goal? Seize the straits, allow for supplies and manpower to be siphoned into Ofenhind.

[/Spoiler]

The attacking Anti-Principalists had managed to convince 40,000 to march on the Office, equipping toughly half of those 40k with weapons dropped through shipments from United Hydronia. With little to no ammunition however, most would be forced to use a single magazine before tossing the weapon or picking up something the Tallislandics had dropped. 

Michał Grabarczyk, a Karwbridc local was assigned with leading the charge into the Office, and spoke outside of the gates to the makeshift fortress for several hours giving words of encouragement to the protestors and rioters that had gathered. 

By five P.M the automatic daylight-sensor lights of the Office kicked on, which signaled that the attack was to begin. "The Cudzothko never cared for democracy, it was only ever justification for their oppression of true Tallialandics. This faux democracy and their oppression ends today!"

 Those were the final words spoken by Grabarczyk before the gates to the Office were breached by rioters, to which Tallislandic soldiers reluctantly opened fire upon. Atleast thirty were cut down in the first charge, hit by standard 556 infantry rounds and even the 12.7mm armor piercing rounds. It was a gory affair, rioters charging past the corpses toward the soldiers and officers like zombies, some being beaten to death and others being chained up. The Young Tallislandics in the crowd returned fire to rooftop snipers, detaching KMDK machine guns to pelt snipers with armor piercing rounds. 

The single Mikavonov frigate stationed at the Office loaded it's cannon to fire gas shells at the rioters hoping to drive them back, only for them to begin donning homemade masks made from bandanas and other clothes. Subsequently, panicked, the lead officer granted permission to load cluster munitions, which were fired without gaining permission from the rest of the stationed fleet.

Dozens killed instantly, dozens more injured or filled with shrapnel. Even several Tallislandic soldiers were killed by the cluster munitions. The advance of the rebels was indeed halted, if only for a couple seconds. Enraged at the countless deaths of their comrades, the rebels charged for the armory, intending to take the rocket launchers there to destroy the ships docked at the port. 

The rebels grinded through the lobby of the armory, fighting intense room-to-room combat against the soldiers. Naturally the soldiers had an advantage in training, but there was simply too many for them to deal with. All of the soldiers in the armory were rounded up, and tortured into teaching the rebels there how to operate the weaponry. 

To limit what could be taken, the Tallislandic navy again took the insane decision to fire an anti-ship missile at the building to prevent the rebels from seizing the armament in the building, killing around 3,000 individuals including their own allies. 

This was enough to warrant both the surrender of soldiers in the barracks and the academy building due to grief, and the orders from Kjersti Stennes to [i]send in the reinforcements.[/i]

Gründer Industries had been a close ally to Stennes and her Young Tallisland, and had given some of it's newest equipment to the AWN to test out in Nevonia and in Flousech, including the X-00 5th generation stealth fighter and XB-00 stealth bomber variant. Eight XB-00s took off from Brëckaloo, accompanied by twelve X-00s from Aardbuer in the Azraël squadron.

These aircraft bore the symbols of the Free Tallisland movement: a triangle with seven stars in it, and some Gründer iconography. By morning of September 10, the Azraël squadron arrived in style. Anti-ship missiles were launched from 4 of the XB-00s, disabling both cruisers, and two corvettes. An additional two XB-00s dropped fuel-air-explosive-bombs on the deck of the Baptism of Morawik, preventing hostile aircraft from taking off to put up a resistance.

Emboldened by the friendly air-power, some of the soldiers that had switched sides joined the rebellion in making the final charge into the administrative building of the office. Again, their training was dwarfed by that of their enemy, especially now that they were fighting the special forces contingent assigned to the protection of the High Naval-priest.

What advantage they did hold was quickly replaced by increasingly better armed rebels and even some deserters, who swept through every floor of the building before finally taking the High Naval-priest into custody. The rebellion stormed the docked ships after, forcing them all to surrender or be shot.

Michał Grabarczyk, assigned to administer the office now by the Coalition, did his best to prevent war crimes being committed against the prisoners, to around 50% effectiveness. Two firing squad executions were arranged without his permission, to which the perpetrators were quickly chained alongside those they had just attempted to kill. The decision was made by Grabarczyk to move all soldiers in his custody to the barracks and lock it off, patrolling the building routinely and making something of a temporary prison.

The following day, September 11th 2026, Holy President Clifford Prisk made a national statement regarding the seizure of the Naval Command Office. "Tallislandic heroes defeated the pagans, dethroned the monarchists, toppled the Islamists, saved Christian values, upheld Lusandric principles and chased down the terrorists to the very ends of Erene. We are now in the process of defeating the radicals the communists, the anarchists, the ethno-nationalists, the looters and people who in many instances have absolutely no clue what they are doing. Those that carried out unholy and gruesome attacks against our faithful troops in Karwbridc will face the full wrath of God, I can assure all Tallislandics and even those abroad, who would see myself and my people as weak. But know this, Erene. Tallisland will remain as the longest lasting democracy in this planet so long as I live, and I shan't allow these leftist-paganistic-eco-terrorists to subvert the greatest Christian state in the history of Erene." 

By now, a civil war was truly underway. Smaller troop movements would be made around Górzynka by the government to encircle rebel movements, and the AWN would properly enter the war by seizing the Szbulban islands of Szczepanik, Drzewiecki, Czochralski, Kotschy, and Pasha. Their goal? Seize the straits, allow for supplies and manpower to be siphoned into Ofenhind.
